observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 40 "https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/models" -o /tmp/ve.json -w "[%{http_code}] "; python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/ve.json'))['data']
print('total:',len(d))
for m in d:
    mid=m['id']; pr=m.get('model_spec',{}).get('pricing',{})
    print(f\"  {mid:42} in={pr.get('input',{}).get('usd')} out={pr.get('output',{}).get('usd')}\")
" 2>&1 | head -40
